The four browser failures came down to one app bug, two outdated tests and one failure I couldn't reproduce. Fixes are committed locally and the full acceptance run is going again:

| Test | Cause | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Home drag | **Real bug:** the empty "Waiting for you" slot took a full row, so nothing could sit beside the first widget | Fixed in `home-grid.tsx`; if decisions are waiting, that slot still takes the row |
| Phone swipe | Outdated test: waiting items pushed the first widget off-screen, so the touch landed on nothing | Test fixed |
| Organization rules | Outdated test: it looked for the old `Disable` button name | Test fixed |
| Import history | "Import history is unavailable" appeared during the full run, but the test passed when rerun alone | Not fixed; probably the 10-second load timeout under load, and the full run will show if it comes back |

The run does a new build, reruns the three fixed tests, then does the required suite. PR #140 gets updated only if that passes.
